slices.focus: A Baltimore museum educators meetup introduces self-paced audio ideas and sharpens Colleen's preference for compact, sustainable formats.
slices.summary: Colleen attends a small museum educators meetup in Baltimore and becomes interested in compact audio guides that let visitors move at their own pace (reducing live narration pressure). She also re-engages with portable activity kits. The trip confirms that her short Northeast train trips have evolved from leisure into deliberate field research for adaptable education formats. She plans a single-room audio pilot and captures portable-kit notes before they scatter.
open_loops: Single-room audio stop prototype -- needs ninety-second script and test with Owen
Portable-kit idea documented but not yet designed
Political framing needed: 'adding another lane' not 'replacing guides'
